notablePrerequisites: Lore Broker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lore Broker by tapping it, causing each player to loot.
Xyris' first ability triggers for each card opponents draw this way, creating that many 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
The Snakes enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
